## Chimera v1.1.22 - the pause fix

Three changes, all aimed at the macro going quiet mid-session.

### Shake timeout halved, 30 s to 16 s

When a bite doesn't produce a shake button, the macro used to stand still for a full thirty seconds before recasting. A 4.5-minute session log showed one of those dead waits (`idle_ms=30022`) in a run that caught nothing.

The watchdog only counts time since the last successful click, so a real shake that keeps landing clicks never trips it. A bite that never arrives now costs 16 seconds instead of 30 - which is what ExoPanda ships.

It is also tunable now, without a rebuild:

```
SHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS = 16000
```

Add that line to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Chimera\config\fisch.cfg` and it applies live. Values under 1000 are ignored.

### Phantom-rail guard

`reel.bar` is the static background rail. The parts that move are its children, `reel.bar.playerbar` and `reel.bar.fish`.

The old liveness test accepted either child. A stale GUI pointer could therefore keep resolving the rail after the minigame was gone, and the macro would enter a catch that did not exist: `[Reel] Reeling...` logged, zero mouse presses issued because there was nothing to chase, the stuck detector ending it a second later, then a recast into the same dead rail.

His log was exactly that shape - 20 casts in 285 seconds, no press events, no catches.

Both children are now required. A genuine reel keeps both resolvable, and the existing 500 ms holdover still bridges a single dropped read.

Set `REEL_REQUIRE_FISH = false` in `fisch_data.lua` to restore the old behaviour.

### Unchanged

Version bump touches the app stamp only - farming, ESP, aquarium, custom rods, harpoon, minigames and telemetry are as they were in 1.1.21.

The exploits module remains fully removed.

### Known unverified

Nothing in this build has been run against a live Roblox client. Live ESP confirmation and real webhook delivery are both still outstanding.
